title: Storyblok
description: Storyblok publishes its palette in its official brand guidelines PDF, which is linked from its press page: Yale Blue (#274793), Electric Violet (#8D60FF), Golden Yellow (#F5C003), Graphite Grey (#1F1F1F) and Cloud Grey (#DFE3E8), with accents Flame Red (#EB4B28), Vibrant Orange (#FF9204) and Alien Green (#396C08).
